transcript.text: Good morning. Before I sign off on the room assignments and controls for the annex, I need to hear from facilities and signal. Please report any room requirements, infrastructure needs, or opening requirements for the East and West rooms. Both can be made ready tomorrow morning, and we'll have an equipment-issue desk and a protected medical-records desk to place. What do you need from me to get this done?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, facilities has a critical floor-load concern. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. I verified the room ratings this morning: East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. That means the equipment-issue desk with its cabinet must go in West Room — East Room cannot safely support it. I should note the floor-load figures haven't been added to the relocation worksheet yet, but the measurements are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, signal has a critical room requirement. The protected medical-records desk can only connect to the required isolated network through the fiber patch panel located in East Room. I have a signal technician booked to certify that connection tomorrow from 0900 to 1000 — I received the booking confirmation this morning, but it hasn't been added to the annex opening checklist yet. This means the medical-records desk needs to go in East Room, and we need that certification window factored into the opening timeline.
